description.value: Hatam is an authentic Persian restaurant on Marine Drive in West Vancouver with over 17 years of culinary experience, specializing in traditional kebabs, slow-cooked stews, and saffron rice dishes. The restaurant offers a curated bar with wine, craft beer, and Persian-inspired cocktails alongside its full dining menu. Cyclists can stop in for a sit-down meal or grab takeout, with catering available for larger groups.
